description: Access nsIMsgDBHdr flags (Replied/Forwarded/Read) and the local `tm-action` string property which drives per-message AI action tinting/sorting.

functions.name: setAction
functions.description: Set the AI action ('reply'/'archive'/'delete'/'none') as a local mork string property on the message header, and invalidate the row so it re-renders. Pass null/empty action to clear.

functions.name: clearAction
functions.description: Clear the AI action string property on the message header.

functions.name: setActionsBulk
functions.description: Bulk-set AI actions on many headers in one call. Used by the startup backfill to populate mork properties from IDB.

functions.name: getAction
functions.description: Read the AI action string property from a message header (for debugging / tests; the painter reads it synchronously).

functions.name: getRepliedBulk
functions.description: Bulk read of nsMsgMessageFlags.Replied by WebExtension message id. A message that is gone reads as false.

functions.name: getHasReBulk
functions.description: Bulk read of nsMsgMessageFlags.HasRe (the original subject had a 'Re:' prefix) by WebExtension message id. A message that is gone reads as false.

functions.name: getHasAttachmentBulk
functions.description: Bulk read of nsMsgMessageFlags.Attachment by WebExtension message id. Each result is true, false, or null when the message is gone or its header could not be read.
